title: Long-Distance Movers in Garden Grove | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Garden Grove long distance movers on one flat rate, with a truck for your household alone and street and HOA rules checked before loading day.
heroSubtitle: One truck, one crew and one flat price, from your Garden Grove address to the new state

faq.question: Does the moving truck need a permit to park on my street?
faq.answer: In Garden Grove it does, whenever it stands on a public street: the city treats a vehicle over 22 feet long or over 80 inches wide as oversized, and an oversized vehicle needs a permit. The permit is free, but the resident pulls it, against a driver’s license and proof of residency, and it covers 72 hours before and 72 hours after the trip. We raise this the day you book, so nobody is filing paperwork while the crew waits.

faq.question: Do you charge by the hour for a long-distance move?
faq.answer: No. Hourly rates apply to our local crews only; a move that crosses a state line, or a California run past 150 miles, is quoted as one flat rate. That rate covers the truck, the fuel, the mileage and the labor at both ends, and a $50 deposit holds the date and comes off the final bill.

faq.question: Can you load out of a mobile home park or an HOA community?
faq.answer: Yes, and the office becomes part of the plan. We ask for the park or association rules on truck access and hours when the date is booked, agree an arrival window with the manager, and issue a certificate of insurance for $50 if the property requires one. The crew then carries from the unit to wherever the truck is allowed to stand.

faq.question: How long does delivery take from here to another state?
faq.answer: From a few days, with the window depending on the route rather than on a fixed table of miles. Because your household is the only load on board, we are not waiting for other shipments to fill the trailer. The window goes in writing on the estimate, and we call before the truck reaches the new address.

faq.question: Can you move on the day I call?
faq.answer: Sometimes, when a crew and a truck are free. Our line is open Monday to Sunday, 8AM to 6PM, and a same-day departure still needs the inventory and the access details before we can put a number on it. If the address sits behind a gate or inside a managed property, allow time for the permit or the certificate of insurance.

faq.question: What does a piano or a very heavy single item cost?
faq.answer: A piano is $200 and travels with a four-mover crew. Any other single item over 300 lbs is $150 and moves with a three-mover crew. Both appear on the estimate before loading day, along with a second truck at $200 if one household needs two.
